name: reformation-fl
title: Florida Reformation of Instruments, 1853-2026
description: Every Florida state appellate decision litigating the reformation of a legal instrument -- will, trust, deed, contract or insurance policy -- with the instrument type, the kind of drafting error alleged, the outcome, and which statutory regime was in force. Florida authorised trust reformation in 2007 (s. 736.0415) and will reformation in 2011 (s. 732.615); before those dates the remedy rested on equity, and for wills was unavailable entirely. The dataset makes that break observable within one jurisdiction.

sources.title: CourtListener bulk export, topped up nightly from the courts

fields.name: cid
fields.description: CourtListener cluster id; one decision may hold several opinions

fields.name: court
fields.description: CourtListener court id (fla = Supreme Court of Florida, fladistctapp = District Courts of Appeal)

fields.name: cites
fields.description: times the decision has been cited, per CourtListener

fields.name: instrument
fields.description: will | trust | deed | contract | insurance | uncertain

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: granted | denied | sought | rule_stated | authority | uncertain -- see the codebook; only granted and denied are holdings

fields.name: regime
fields.description: statutory | pre-statute | equitable | unknown -- which reformation regime governed that instrument on that date

fields.name: errors
fields.description: comma-separated error types alleged; multi-label by design

fields.name: n_reform_sents
fields.description: count of reformation sentences found in the opinion

fields.name: cites_statute
fields.description: 1 where the opinion cites s. 732.615, s. 732.616 or s. 736.0415

fields.name: key_sentence
fields.description: the sentence the outcome label was read from, verbatim

fields.name: statement
fields.description: the row written as one self-contained English sentence, so it can be retrieved, quoted and checked on its own

run.query: (reformation OR reformed OR reforming OR reform OR scrivener OR "mutual mistake" OR "unilateral mistake" OR "drafting error" OR "732.615" OR "736.0415" OR "732.616") AND (will OR trust OR deed OR codicil OR testament OR contract OR policy OR beneficiary OR settlor OR grantor OR conveyance)
